second_source_check.method: Every game designation printed in the NFL.com Week 10 injury article was compared with the designation column of the NFL.com injury-report page for the same player.
second_source_check.reading: The two official NFL.com pages do not agree on Week 10 designations. The injury article names more Out players (for example three Lions) than the injury-report page prints. This is published as a flag; no value is reconciled by inference, and the report-page value is shown as published while the article value is shown beside it.

interpretation_limits: A club depth chart is a publication, not a lineup. It does not prove who starts.
Injury designations do not prove a player is inactive, and a blank game status is not 'active'.
'Next man up' is the next name in published order at the same position, nothing more.
Confirmed replacement, confirmed active status and expected snaps are UNKNOWN and left blank.
Snap-count data would be the official way to confirm workload, but no official snap-count source is captured for 2026 in this repository.
